message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
I’ve pulled the dates from the federal holiday schedule (and the standard “observe‑on‑Monday” rule that applies when a holiday falls on a weekend).  Provincial holidays that create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, etc.) are noted where relevant, but the list focuses on the nationwide long weekends that will affect most Canadians.

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Monday | Long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Friday | Long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | Long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so observed on Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so observed on Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |

### Quick‑reference JSON (useful for API integration)

```json
{
  "long_weekends_2023": [
    {"date":"2023-02-20","holiday":"Family Day","province":"Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario"},
    {"date":"2023-03-17","holiday":"St. Patrick's Day","province":"Ontario"},
    {"date":"2023-04-07","holiday":"Good Friday"},
    {"date":"2023-05-22","holiday":"Victoria Day"},
    {"date":"2023-07-03","holiday":"Canada Day (observed)"},
    {"date":"2023-09-04","holiday":"Labour Day"},
    {"date":"2023-10-09","holiday":"Thanksgiving"},
    {"date":"2023-11-13","holiday":"Remembrance Day (observed)"},
    {"date":"2023-12-25","holiday":"Christmas Day"}
  ]
}
```

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support provincial variations, you can add a `province` field to each entry and filter by the user’s location.  
> For example, Family Day is only a federal holiday in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, and Ontario, while St. Patrick’s Day is only in Ontario.

Let me know if you’d like the full provincial holiday list or any other formatting!
